lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Supervised application: reading an official notice and responding

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic reading an official notice and responding task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: Given a fictional sample official-style notice (an invented sender, an invented reference number, a fictional stated deadline and required action), the learner drafts a response and reviews the draft with an adult who checks that it correctly captures the deadline, the required action, and includes a clarifying question for anything unclear.
safetyNotes: The notice, sender, and reference number are entirely invented; no real official notice needs to be shared or discussed.
This is not legal advice; the review checks whether the response correctly reflects the fictional notice's own stated content, not whether the response is legally correct.

simulationAlternative.description: If no adult is available for a live review today, the learner self-reviews the draft against the same three-point checklist (deadline captured, action captured, clarifying question included) and flags any point they're unsure about.

materials: learner-local: the provided fictional official-style notice

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Was the hardest part of this task drafting the response, or correctly reading the fictional notice in the first place? Why?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Notice comprehension: The response correctly captures both the deadline and the required action. | Review integration: The revision directly addresses what the review caught. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner draft a second response to a harder fictional notice with a shorter deadline and an ambiguous required action, and explain how their approach changed.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic reading an official notice and responding task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: 10–20 minutes for permission, required supervision or review, and physical-event attestation

localMaterials.label: the provided fictional official-style notice
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: reading an official notice and responding worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Given a fictional sample official-style notice (an invented sender, an invented reference number, a fictional stated deadline and required action), the learner drafts a response and reviews the draft with an adult who checks that it correctly captures the deadline, the required action, and includes a clarifying question for anything unclear.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact reading an official notice and responding decision or action.
Model move 2: Before drafting, list what tends to make an official notice confusing to read.
Model move 3: Draft a response to the fictional notice and review it with an adult (or self-review).
Model check: Notice comprehension: The response correctly captures both the deadline and the required action. | Review integration: The revision directly addresses what the review caught.

resources.title: reading an official notice and responding action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for reading an official notice and responding.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: reading an official notice and responding coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Given a fictional sample official-style notice (an invented sender, an invented reference number, a fictional stated deadline and required action), the learner drafts a response and reviews the draft with an adult who checks that it correctly captures the deadline, the required action, and includes a clarifying question for anything unclear.
Coach direction: Before drafting, list what tends to make an official notice confusing to read.
Learner prompt: What is one thing that tends to make an official-sounding notice hard to read quickly and correctly?
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: reading an official notice and responding complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Draft a response to the fictional notice and review it with an adult (or self-review).
Response 1 (t2-p1): My draft response correctly states the deadline from the fictional notice.
Response 2 (t2-p2): My draft response correctly states the required action from the fictional notice.
Response 3 (t2-p3): My draft response includes a clarifying question for anything unclear.

Equal-access rule: If no adult is available for a live review today, the learner self-reviews the draft against the same three-point checklist (deadline captured, action captured, clarifying question included) and flags any point they're unsure about.

resources.title: reading an official notice and responding minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Was the hardest part of this task drafting the response, or correctly reading the fictional notice in the first place? Why?
Success checks: Notice comprehension: The response correctly captures both the deadline and the required action. | Review integration: The revision directly addresses what the review caught.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: reading an official notice and responding supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional reading an official notice and responding condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Notice comprehension: The response correctly captures both the deadline and the required action. | Review integration: The revision directly addresses what the review caught..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

realRoute.title: reading an official notice and responding — permitted real-life route
realRoute.permissionRule: Do not begin the physical action until a household-authorized guardian gives permission and is available for the supervision or review named in this lesson.

Draft a response to the fictional notice and review it with an adult (or self-review).
Complete the response prompts on the delivered independent card without recording private identifying details.

realRoute.completionCondition: The learner submits the minimal process record; only the household-authorized guardian attests that the named physical action occurred.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Notice comprehension: The response correctly captures both the deadline and the required action. | Review integration: The revision directly addresses what the review caught.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g12-u04-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
